Exchange Online – Forwarding and Inbox Rules

This report focuses on forwarding-related configurations in Exchange Online. It is especially useful for detecting potential business email compromise risks, external data leakage, and unwanted automatic message delivery.

It covers both mailbox-level forwarding and tenant-wide inbox-rule-related configurations where they are directly available in CIPP reports.
